items.text: Today, as I sat by my window watching the storm clouds gather outside, I couldn't help but think about Tiger Shroff's latest movie. Suddenly, a loud rumble echoed through the air and I realized Hurricane Trudy was approaching. It looked like we'd be stuck indoors for a while now. I remembered hearing that Anthropic had developed an AI system to predict such weather patterns, though I didn't know if they were accurate.
